🌡️ MARKET ATMOSPHERE

1. Global Risk Regime?
NEUTRAL. Breadth: 6/11 sectors positive. Core risk ratios read mixed/flat (VXX (1W: -3.59% | 1M: -8.41%) ↓ falling but regime flags overall NEUTRAL; SPY_TLT neutral → flat), while sector leadership is split with XLK ABOVE TREND (1W: +7.00% | 1M: +9.08%) vs XLE BELOW TREND (1W: -1.31% | 1M: -2.67%).

2. Primary Risk Drivers?
Risk metrics broadly neutral: VXX shows lower realized fear (VXX (1W: -3.59% | 1M: -8.41%) ↓ falling | BELOW TREND) but credit and stocks-vs-bonds read flat (HYG/LQD → flat | NEUTRAL). Tech strength (XLK ABOVE TREND) and EM strength (EEM ABOVE TREND) are pro-risk offsets to defensive weakness in staples/utilities.

3. Financial Conditions Signal?
Neutral: TLT BELOW TREND (1W: -0.48% | 1M: -0.94%) → flat and U.S. rates/dollar measures read flat per the barometer, indicating no decisive easing or tightening impulse for risk assets.

📈 EQUITIES & FLOWS

4. Sector Leadership?
Growth/momentum leadership but breadth mixed: XLK ABOVE TREND (1W: +7.00% | 1M: +9.08%) and SOXX ABOVE TREND (1W: +7.22% | 1M: +19.31%) showing strength, while XLP BELOW TREND (1W: -2.42% | 1M: -3.32%) and XLE BELOW TREND flag selective weakness; Style: Growth leading but not universally broad.

5. US vs Global?
US equities strong: SPY ABOVE TREND (1W: +3.20% | 1M: +4.89%) and QQQ ABOVE TREND (1W: +4.96% | 1M: +6.29%); EM also robust with EEM ABOVE TREND (1W: +3.60% | 1M: +6.30%) and FXI ABOVE TREND (1W: +2.59% | 1M: +0.92%), so outperformance is not US-only.

6. Speculative Appetite?
Speculation intact: ARKK ABOVE TREND (1W: +12.22% | 1M: +5.86%) and IBIT ABOVE TREND (1W: +4.45% | 1M: +1.09%) show risk-on positioning, small caps IWM ABOVE TREND (1W: +3.05% | 1M: +7.96%) confirm appetite.

🛢️ REAL ECONOMY

7. Commodities Theme?
Industrial/metal demand picking up: CPER ABOVE TREND (1W: +4.91% | 1M: +4.91%) ↑ rising. Precious metals mixed: GLD RECOVERY (1W: +0.50% | 1M: -4.18%) showing short-term bounce.

8. Energy Trend?
Energy mixed-to-weak: XLE BELOW TREND (1W: -1.31% | 1M: -2.67%) ↓ falling while Brent BNO RECOVERY (1W: +1.15% | 1M: -0.65%) shows tactical rebound; natural gas UNG BELOW TREND (1W: -0.92% | 1M: -11.64%) remains weak.

🧭 STRATEGY

9. Trend Confirmation?
CONFIRMED: Major equities and semis are ABOVE TREND (SPY (1W: +3.20% | 1M: +4.89%) ABOVE TREND; XLK ABOVE TREND) giving conviction on risk tilt; DIVERGENCE: bonds/TLT BELOW TREND and select defensive sectors below trend — overall a minor divergence, not a regime break.

10. Portfolio Direction?
Favor growth/tech exposure while monitoring cyclicals: XLK, SOXX, QQQ showing strength; reduce exposure to defensives showing weakness (XLP, XLE) and monitor bond signals given TLT BELOW TREND.

🔮 NEXT WEEK OUTLOOK

11. Sectors to Watch?
BULLISH: Technology (XLK (1W: +7.00% | 1M: +9.08%) ABOVE TREND), Semiconductors (SOXX (1W: +7.22% | 1M: +19.31%) ABOVE TREND). BEARISH: Energy (XLE (1W: -1.31% | 1M: -2.67%) BELOW TREND), Staples (XLP (1W: -2.42% | 1M: -3.32%) BELOW TREND).

12. Commodities to Watch?
BULLISH: Copper/industrial metals (CPER (1W: +4.91% | 1M: +4.91%) ABOVE TREND). BEARISH: Natural gas (UNG (1W: -0.92% | 1M: -11.64%) BELOW TREND) and palladium/other laggards (PALL (1W: -0.21% | 1M: -3.09%) BELOW TREND).

13. Key Levels?
VXX ~20 (complacency pivot), HYG/LQD ~0.80 (credit health), XLK/XLF breakpoint for growth vs value rotation, SPY 1M support/resilience at recent ABOVE TREND consolidation.

📝 EXECUTIVE SUMMARY

NEUTRAL. Breadth: 6/11 sectors positive supporting a mixed, non-consensus market stance. Tech and semis showing clear strength (XLK, SOXX ABOVE TREND) while bonds and defensives lag — watch TLT and staples/energy divergence for next directional cue.
